description: This file contains IRQ (Interrupt Request) handling and initialization code specific to x86 architecture on Zephyr RTOS, including vector allocation, IRQ connection, and handling spurious interrupts.

methods.name: x86_64_irq_init
methods.description: Initializes IRQ vectors with spurious interrupt handler.

methods.name: z_x86_allocate_vector
methods.description: Allocates an IRQ vector based on priority and previous vector.

methods.name: z_x86_irq_connect_on_vector
methods.description: Connects an IRQ to a specific vector with a handler and argument.

methods.name: arch_irq_connect_dynamic
methods.description: Dynamically connects an IRQ with a handler, priority, and flags, allocating a vector.

methods.name: irq_init
methods.description: Initializes the IRQ reserved list based on linker section data.

methods.name: arch_irq_is_used
methods.description: Checks if an IRQ is marked as used.
